## What is here

`GUIDE.md` - the full article, verbatim as pasted. 23 sections: idea selection
(problem-first, tarpit ideas, different-mechanism, reverse-engineering the viral
video, the "gotcha moment"), build discipline, onboarding/paywall structure,
the $100 -> $1k -> $10k MRR ladder, four distribution channels (organic /
UGC + meme pages / influencers / paid ads) with concrete deal mechanics
(CPM/RPM math, DM scripts, objection handling), metrics (ARPU, retention), and
where VC-canon advice does not transfer to bootstrapped consumer apps.

Note the source bias: Rork sells an AI app builder, and sections 1, 10 and the
case studies double as product marketing. The distribution and deal-mechanics
chapters (14-20) are the load-bearing part - they are attributed to a named
user (George, Wrestle AI) and are checkable against our own numbers.

## How it relates to our own docs

- Verdicts we adopt are recorded in `SOTA.md` as `[directional]` (sections
  Idea Selection and Distribution, plus additions to Onboarding, Paywalls, and
  Growth & Analytics, dated 2026-08-17) until we ship against them ourselves.
- `IDEA-ROAST.md` is our negative checklist distilled from the guide's idea
  chapters plus our own ledger rules - the roast list is ours, the guide is its
  main evidence source.
- Where the guide disagrees with an existing `[sota]` verdict (e.g. its
  $9.99/$59.99 annual-only-trial pricing vs our Adapty-backed weekly+trial LTV
  verdict), the SOTA entry names the tension - the guide never silently
  overrides a ledger.
- Onboarding claims overlap `mobile-onboarding-catalog` (P1-P17); the catalog
  stays authoritative for pattern names and benchmarks.
